verdict.rationale: Drata publishes an llms.txt at help.drata.com/llms.txt, and the evidence items sourced from it show it carries help-center content, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, the developer portal's llms.txt returns 404, as do the markdown doc variant and every probed machine-readable OpenAPI path, so API-focused agent docs are not exposed in agent-friendly form. Missing for 10: llms.txt on developers.drata.com, markdown versions of the docs, a fetchable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how usable the help-center llms.txt is.
